heading: Authorization of appropriations

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: Subject to subsection (b), there is authorized to be appropriated to the corporation for operation and maintenance expenses $500,000 for each of fiscal years 2008 through 2017.

tree.heading: Limitation.—
tree.text: Any Federal funds made available under subsection (a) shall be matched on a 1-to-1 basis by non-Federal funds.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 111–11, title XIII, § 13006, Mar. 30, 2009, 123 Stat. 1452.)
